cleanExplanation: Convert both reactants to moles: 2.00 g salicylic acid / 138.12 g/mol = 0.01448 mol, and 2.00 g acetic anhydride / 102.09 g/mol = 0.01959 mol. Because the reaction is 1:1, salicylic acid is the limiting reagent and sets the maximum aspirin formed: 0.01448 mol x 180.16 g/mol = 2.61 g. Applying the 85.0% yield gives 2.61 g x 0.850 = 2.22 g of aspirin collected.
